scope: Whole OptionsForm.activate in untouched original/raw/delivered MIDP2-RU application classes. Only the manifest changes and an inert host MIDlet is added; no application method, callsite or resource is instrumented. 82 explicit model states per version cover valid flag combinations, cached-state seeds, sort boundaries, null/wrong typed options and two competing errors. Observe exception classes, four previous-state caches, real menu line counts and the full option table. Corrupt states are supplied inputs, not a claim they all arise through ordinary physical UI/RMS operation. All fifteen native/delivered and three raw read frontiers retain full bodies, fields and compiler differences; full-program equivalence is not claimed.
